name: Oracle Manipulation
description: Price or other data can be manipulated due to reliance on manipulable sources

detectors.name: Spot Price Usage
detectors.description: Using spot price from DEX as price oracle (manipulable)

detectors.name: No TWAP/TWAP Insufficient
detectors.description: No time-weighted average price protection or insufficient period

detectors.name: Single Oracle Dependency
detectors.description: Protocol relies on single price source without fallback

detectors.name: LP Token Pricing Vulnerability
detectors.description: Pricing LP tokens based on underlying reserves (vulnerable to donation attacks)

remediation: Use Chainlink or other robust oracle networks, implement TWAP with sufficient period, use multiple oracle sources with aggregation
